title: Match forecasts in UEFA club competitions: Elo ratings versus Transfermarkt valuations
abstract: arXiv:2609.21674v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The pre-season strengths of European football clubs are usually measured by two proxies in the literature. Football Club Elo Ratings provide strictly performance-based Elo ratings from the early days of the European Cups, while Transfermarkt valuations are crowd-based estimates of squad market values. This paper compares them by evaluating their ability to forecast the results of matches played in the UEFA Champions League and the UEFA Europa League between the seasons 2020/21 and 2024/25. The two indicators yield almost identical out-of-sample accuracy when used separately. Combining the two measures leads to a modest improvement, but the best aggregation procedure is sensitive to the forecast target. Our results suggest that seeding based on Elo ratings would be (closely) optimal.

translated_title: 欧足联俱乐部赛事中的比赛预测：Elo评级与Transfermarkt估值之比较
translated_abstract: 在相关文献中，欧洲足球俱乐部赛季前的实力通常通过两种替代指标来衡量。足球俱乐部Elo评级（Football Club Elo Ratings）提供了自欧洲杯创立初期以来完全基于比赛表现的Elo评级，而Transfermarkt估值则是对球队阵容市场价值的群体估计。本文通过评估这两种指标预测2020/21赛季至2024/25赛季期间欧洲冠军联赛和欧罗巴联赛比赛结果的能力，对二者进行了比较。当单独使用时，这两种指标在样本外预测准确率上几乎完全相同。将两者结合会带来适度的改进，但最佳的聚合方法取决于具体的预测目标。我们的结果表明，基于Elo评级的种子队排序将是（接近）最优的。
tldr: 本研究比较了足球俱乐部Elo评级与Transfermarkt市场估值在预测2020/21至2024/25赛季欧冠和欧联比赛结果方面的能力，发现两者单独使用时预测准确率几乎相同，且基于Elo评级的种子队排序是接近最优的选择。
en_tdlr: This study compares Football Club Elo Ratings and Transfermarkt valuations in forecasting UEFA Champions League and Europa League match results from 2020/21 to 2024/25, finding that the two indicators yield almost identical out-of-sample accuracy when used separately and that Elo-based seeding would be (closely) optimal.
